investigation_summary.approach: Intelligence-driven angle: searched admissions class-profile microsites, blog roundups, third-party aggregators (Compass Prep, College Transitions, PrepScholar, CollegeVine, testbook.com), and downloaded each school's most recent Common Data Set (2024-25 where available) to inspect Section C11 directly.
investigation_summary.strict_quality_bar: Per task spec, only CLOSED if (1) source EXPLICITLY says unweighted, (2) data has 3+ band partitions, (3) two independent sources confirm. Rejected weighted GPA, mean+SD, single-threshold figures, and CDS C11 data that doesn't specify weighted vs unweighted.
investigation_summary.key_finding: Virtually no school in this dataset publishes the 5-band unweighted GPA distribution our engine needs. Elite LACs (Williams, Amherst, Swarthmore, Pomona, Wellesley, etc.) publish class rank in lieu of GPA. Selective privates (Notre Dame, Georgetown, Rice, Wake Forest, BC, Lehigh, American) leave CDS C11 blank or report only mid-50% range. Public flagships (Rutgers NB, UC Irvine, Texas A&M, UTSA, UMN, JMU, UConn, U Missouri) also leave C11 blank or mark 'C or t' (cannot/not reported). Specialty/art schools (RISD, SAIC, SCAD, Berklee, Juilliard, MICA, CalArts, Curtis, New England Conservatory, Cooper Union, ArtCenter, CCA) report only averages — portfolio-driven admissions de-emphasize formal GPA reporting.

candidate_data_points_evaluated_and_reje.rejection_reason: CDS does not specify weighted vs unweighted, and ~38% perfect 4.0 strongly indicates weighted GPA. Davidson's own admissions site characterizes typical competitive applicant as 'unweighted 3.85+' — inconsistent with 38% being perfect 4.0 unweighted. Per strict quality bar, REJECT.
CDS does not specify weighted vs unweighted. 82% with perfect 4.0 is implausible as unweighted — strongly indicates weighted (consistent with HS reporting to college). Per strict bar, REJECT.

investigation_summary.strengthened_unavailable_reason: After cross-referencing class-profile microsites, admissions blog roundups, Compass/College Transitions/PrepScholar aggregators, and the school's own Common Data Set Section C11 (downloaded and parsed where accessible), no source publishes a 5-band UNWEIGHTED GPA distribution that meets the strict quality bar. Schools that fill CDS C11 (Davidson, Smith) report unspecified-scale data inconsistent with our unweighted-4.0 engine. Elite LACs (Williams, Amherst, Swarthmore, Pomona, Wellesley, Bowdoin, Middlebury, Carleton, Harvey Mudd) report class rank percentile in lieu of GPA. Selective privates (Notre Dame, Georgetown, Rice, Wake Forest, BC, Lehigh, American) leave C11 blank. Public flagships and regional publics (Rutgers, UCI, Texas A&M, UTSA, UMN, JMU, UConn, U Missouri, U North Dakota, NMSU, UTA) leave C11 blank or report only mid-50%. Portfolio/audition-driven specialty schools (RISD, SAIC, SCAD, Berklee, Juilliard, Curtis, MICA, NEC, CalArts, ArtCenter, CCA, Cooper Union, New School) prioritize portfolio review and do not publish formal GPA distributions.
